h1: TrueEarth — Education & Community Landing Page Design
tagline: Landing page reference built on #FFFFFF and deep blue #0B2A3A, set in Plus Jakarta Sans and measured against type from 12px to 16px.
summary: Landing page reference for an education or community brand — looping video, #FFFFFF base, max-width 360px and max-width 420px breakpoints and a stats row.
about: TrueEarth was captured at 1920x1422 and kept as a specification rather than as a gallery image. Colour is limited to #FFFFFF underneath, #111417 for the type and deep blue #0B2A3A carrying the accents, set in Plus Jakarta Sans. Delivery is one self-contained HTML file, captured at 1920x1422 so the frame is fixed before any code is written. Motion is 72ms transitions, cubic-bezier(.16,1.3,1) and a looping video bed, kept quiet enough that the copy still leads. It is the right reference for an education or community brand landing page that has to look deliberate on the first screen.

layout.title: Links before the action
layout.body: Navigation is a thin strip rather than a band: wordmark left, links centre-right, one #0B2A3A action, all of it sitting above the landing page without a background of its own. Below 360px the links collapse instead of wrapping onto a second line.

layout.title: Media behind the type
layout.body: The background is a single 6.9s loop at 1920x1422, cropped to cover and left un-tinted. Everything else floats above it on a higher layer. A poster frame at 1920x1422 holds the composition when autoplay is unavailable, so the layout never collapses.

layout.title: A list, not a card wall
layout.body: The features are set as a list in Plus Jakarta Sans rather than as a wall of cards. The list is left-aligned to the same margin as the headline.

layout.title: Top row, one action
layout.body: Design the collapsed state before adding a sixth link. The reference was captured at 1920x1422.

motion.title: Pointer states, nothing more
motion.body: The page answers only where it can be acted on: hover states on the buttons and links rather than on every card. Each state changes one property, which keeps the feedback legible. Check the states on a touch device.

motion.title: Motion can be switched off
motion.body: Reduced motion is specified rather than bolted on: with it on, the entrance and the loop stops and the composition holds its final state. The layout is identical with the motion disabled, so nothing depends on the animation.

fonts.name: Plus Jakarta Sans
fonts.role: Headline and interface text — one face for the whole page

notes: The display line is Plus Jakarta Sans at the top of a 12–16px scale, with the interface text on the same face.
The composition is measured on a 2-column grid, which is why the distances between elements look consistent.
The navigation collapses at max-width 360px and max-width 420px, so the bar has a designed narrow state.

customize: Retint #0B2A3A toward your palette but keep the step against #FFFFFF; flatten the two and the primary action stops reading.
Change #0B2A3A for your brand accent and re-check it against #FFFFFF, because the accent is the only saturated value in this composition.
Replace the copy in the Plus Jakarta Sans stack first, then re-check the #0B2A3A accent against the media behind it.
Retune #0B2A3A for your brand only after the Plus Jakarta Sans copy is final, and re-check the contrast on the darkest band.

editorial.title: Reading TrueEarth as a spec
editorial.body: Type is the first number: type from 12px to 16px and 100vh sections. The spacing follows from it, and everything else on the page is positioned against those two values. Nothing in this landing page depends on a default.

editorial.title: What moves in TrueEarth
editorial.body: Motion is limited to 72ms transitions, a 6.9s media loop and a masked line reveal. Nothing in the landing page animates for longer than the brief allows. Nothing animates for its own sake in this landing page.

editorial.title: How TrueEarth sequences the first read
editorial.body: One screen, one action, and navigation, the headline, the announcement badge, the stats row and the card grid between them. The brief fixes that order rather than leaving the first screen to a stack of sections. A education reader gets the offer before the options.

faq.question: How long is the prompt behind TrueEarth?
faq.answer: The captured brief runs 23,498 characters and covers the frame, the type scale, the palette and the transitions. Copying it gives you that text, and sending it to Studio stages the same request with the page already described.

faq.question: Why does the entry name one self-contained HTML file at all?
faq.answer: TrueEarth was built in one self-contained HTML file, and the entry says so for provenance. The brief describes positions, sizes and timings, so it rebuilds in any framework that can set type and place elements.

faq.question: How is this TrueEarth entry organised?
faq.answer: Everything quoted on the page comes from the captured 23,498-character brief rather than from a description written afterwards. That is why the numbers and the prose agree.

audience: Anyone using an AI builder who wants a brief that already contains cubic-bezier(.16,1.3,1) easing instead of leaving it to the model.
If the build starts from one self-contained HTML file, lift type from 12px to 16px and 100vh sections first and leave the palette alone until the grid settles.
